name: Sunda Energy Plc
summary: Sunda Energy Plc, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an independent energy operating company. It operates a production sharing contract in Timor-Leste that contains a gas field called Chuditch located in Southeast Asia. The company was formerly known as Baron Oil Plc and changed its name to Sunda Energy Plc in June 2024. Sunda Energy Plc was incorporated in 2004 and is based in London, the United Kingdom.
